notes.title: Release v2.0/going free (open source) software
notes.content:
Good news everyone,

I have reimplemented the game in Godot 3 (from Godot 2). This is basically a complete rewrite. It has cleaner code and some minor improvement.
As such I have released it under the MPL2 and it is available on github:
https://github.com/gapophustu/4D-Minesweeper

The previous version is still available as as the legacy branch on steam.

notes.title: Going Free
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am planning to switch the game to be free starting November 1. 2018.

Cheers
